clauses.quote: The Chancellor and President of the WTU shall appoint a Joint Committee to develop uniform standards for classroom resources.
clauses.subject_text: The Chancellor and President of the WTU
clauses.notes: Joint subject directive to form committee.

clauses.quote: The Joint Committee shall provide opportunities for teachers and other educational stakeholders to give input during the process
clauses.notes: Second independent clause from split sentence.

clauses.quote: shall make its final recommendations to the Chancellor and WTU President no later than March 31, 2010.
clauses.notes: Second independent clause from split sentence.

clauses.quote: DCPS agrees to fund the “Certified Classroom” standards of resources annually to the extent possible.
clauses.notes: Funding obligation qualified by discretionary language.

clauses.quote: DCPS and the WTU shall mutually develop and agree on a process for monitoring the implementation of “Certified Classroom’ resource standards in all DCPS classrooms.
Teachers shall have the right to know the names, titles, and reporting relationships of all personnel exercising direct, indirect, technical or administrative supervision over them.
The Supervisor shall furnish Teachers with this information upon request.
